shape in the page, plus two frames. No press, switch or event delay is included.

note: The sparse change and the revisit of the large view redraw every shape while the
large view and its hidden editor are in the page. Each serial export forces a style
and layout pass over the whole document, so time grows faster than the shapes.
revisit_max is the large view shown again from the small one: every shape mounted
anew. The control never repaints, exports or hit-tests a separate print.

steps.change: Export top-level shapes concurrently in batches of 64, not one after another.
Hidden editor without a canvas (components.Canvas null).
steps.effect: Hidden editor mount 170 to 75 on 207 shapes; cold median 549 to 523.

steps.change: Keep up to 6 drawn views (48 MiB), each with its hidden editor.
Reuse a picture while its subtree, bindings and bound shapes are unchanged.
Once default fonts are loaded, name no fonts to exports (textOptions).
TldrawEditor instead of Tldraw for the hidden editor.

combined.pixels: 6 views against baseline screenshots: 4 pixels differ, by 1 of 255.

bottleneck left: tldraw's style embedding for text labels inside getSvgElement, about 54 percent of a
cold switch. Only rendering without per-shape export removes it.
defect found: Kept hidden editors stacked in page flow made #root taller than the window, and the
page scrolled the canvas 153 px off the top (caught by tests/scenes.e2e.ts). Any design
keeping several hidden editors must lay them over one another.
